name: Prosidol
summary: Prosidol is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of prodine.F. MacFarlan and Co. in the 1950s. It was further developed in Russia in the 1990s during research into the related drug pethidine.

sideEffects.text: It produces similar effects to other opioids, such as analgesia and sedation, along with side effects such as nausea, itching, vomiting and respiratory depression which may be harmful or fatal.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to act mainly as an agonist at the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine. This relieves pain and causes euphoria and sedation, but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它主要是 μ 鴉片受體的促效劑，作用目標和嗎啡相同。這會止痛並帶來欣快感和鎮靜，但也會抑制呼吸。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它主要是 μ 鸦片受体的促效剂，作用目标和吗啡相同。这会止痛并带来欣快感和镇静，但也会抑制呼吸。

uses.en: It has been used in Russia as a painkiller, including for cancer pain.
uses.zh: 它在俄羅斯被用作止痛藥，包括治療癌症疼痛。
uses.zhHans: 它在俄罗斯被用作止痛药，包括治疗癌症疼痛。

fact.en: Prosidol was developed further in Russia in the 1990s and was approved there as a painkiller, while it remains almost unknown elsewhere.
fact.zh: Prosidol 於 1990 年代在俄羅斯進一步開發，並在當地獲准作為止痛藥，在其他地方則幾乎無人知曉。
fact.zhHans: Prosidol 于 1990 年代在俄罗斯进一步开发，并在当地获准作为止痛药，在其他地方则几乎无人知晓。
